contentSnippet: NextEra Energy announces major expansion of solar capacity in Florida, targeting 10 GW of new installations by 2026.
Analysts warn of increased regulatory uncertainty in Florida's energy market following recent legislative changes.
Enphase Energy reports Q1 results below expectations as residential solar demand slows amid higher interest rates.
Vestas secures record offshore wind order in the North Sea, strengthening its position as Europe's leading turbine manufacturer.
Microsoft commits $13B additional investment into AI infrastructure, expanding Azure capacity across Europe and Asia.
NVIDIA faces new US export controls on advanced chips to China, potentially impacting up to 20% of annual revenue.
ASML reports strong order backlog for EUV lithography machines, driven by semiconductor capacity expansions in Europe and Japan.
Apple Vision Pro sales disappoint in first quarter; analysts revise spatial computing revenue forecasts downward.
Johnson & Johnson reaches $6.5B settlement in talc litigation, removing a major long-standing legal overhang.
BlackRock scales back ESG commitments under political pressure, raising concerns among sustainability-focused investors.
